title: Everyday Phrases — A Networking Event
scene_zh: 行業交流會 · 情境對話
title_quote: The ticket link is still open.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🤝 實用行業交流會必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Networking Event
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用行業交流會（下班後參加工商同業聚會）情境對話：買票查議程、報到拿名牌、自我介紹、聊行業趨勢、找合作機會、會後跟進約咖啡（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然沉進腦海裡。👍 想學更多職場場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Networking Event phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering tickets and the agenda, check-in badges, self-introductions, industry trends, partnership talk and follow-up coffee meetups. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more workplace scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!
story_hook: 從搶早鳥票、進場換名牌，到會後傳信約咖啡——一場行業交流會怎麼從零經營出兩個真正的機會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ticket link is still open.
dialogue.zh: 購票連結還打得開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, let's buy ours tonight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們今晚就買票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Early bird price ends Friday.
dialogue.zh: 早鳥票週五就截止。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll pay right now.
dialogue.zh: 那我馬上付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pass includes the dinner?
dialogue.zh: 哪一種票附設晚餐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The full pass does, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我想全套票有附。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Student tickets cost less here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡學生票便宜一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My cousin still qualifies for one.
dialogue.zh: 我表哥還符合資格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the payment go through?
dialogue.zh: 扣款成功了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my receipt just arrived.
dialogue.zh: 有，收據剛剛傳來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add a guest later?
dialogue.zh: 之後還能再加一位同行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only before the door list closes.
dialogue.zh: 要在入場名單關閉前才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check the speaker list first.
dialogue.zh: 我們先看看講者名單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first one runs a robotics lab.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɜrst wʌn rʌnz ə ˌroʊˈbɑtɪks læb./
dialogue.zh: 第一位講者是經營機器人實驗室的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the keynote speaker?
dialogue.zh: 誰是本次主講人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A founder from Singapore, apparently.
dialogue.zh: 聽說是新加坡的一位創辦人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The agenda looks pretty packed.
dialogue.zh: 議程看起來排得很滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two panels overlap at seven thirty.
dialogue.zh: 七點半有兩場論壇撞時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only want the technology track.
dialogue.zh: 我只想聽技術那一場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you save the agenda on your phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju seɪv ði əˈdʒɛndə ɑn jʊr foʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 你有把議程表存進手機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a workshop option?
dialogue.zh: 還有工作坊可以選嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small room, fifteen seats only.
dialogue.zh: 小教室只有十五個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The livestream needs a login.
dialogue.zh: 線上直播要登入帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd rather go in person.
dialogue.zh: 我寧可去現場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Print the entry code, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把入場條碼印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can just show my phone screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn dʒʌst ʃoʊ maɪ foʊn skrin./
dialogue.zh: 我直接用手機螢幕給他掃就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need business cards?
dialogue.zh: 我們需要帶名片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Definitely bring a full stack.
dialogue.zh: 一定要帶厚厚一疊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine show my old job title.
dialogue.zh: 我那批印的是舊職稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Order new ones this week, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就這週重印新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The printer promised Wednesday delivery.
dialogue.zh: 印刷廠答應週三送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, the event is Friday.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，活動在週五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many cards should I carry?
dialogue.zh: 我該帶幾張名片去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty feels safe for a crowd.
dialogue.zh: 人多，帶二十張比較保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put them in your jacket pocket.
dialogue.zh: 放進外套口袋就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not the back one, right?
dialogue.zh: 別放後面那個，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I wear that day?
dialogue.zh: 那天我該穿什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Business casual, smart but relaxed.
dialogue.zh: 商務休閒，體面又不緊繃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would a full suit feel odd?
dialogue.zh: 穿整身西裝會怪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably, the vibe is friendly.
dialogue.zh: 大概會，現場氣氛很輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark jeans and a blazer work.
dialogue.zh: 深色牛仔褲加西裝外套就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Comfortable shoes matter most, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過舒服的鞋最重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The forecast says heavy rain.
dialogue.zh: 預報說會下大雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring a foldable umbrella, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就帶一把折疊傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to go together?
dialogue.zh: 你想一起去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let's meet near the entrance.
dialogue.zh: 好呀，我們在入口附近碰面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll drive if you navigate.
dialogue.zh: 你導航，我就開車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I hate parking downtown.
dialogue.zh: 成交，我最討厭市區停車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ask the intern too?
dialogue.zh: 也找實習生一起去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'd love one real industry night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi d lʌv wʌn ril ˈɪndəstri naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 她會很想去見見世面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask the manager about the hours.
dialogue.zh: 跟主管問一下時間安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He approves these things easily.
dialogue.zh: 這種事他很好答應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly is the venue?
dialogue.zh: 場地到底在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The glass tower beside the river.
dialogue.zh: 河邊那棟玻璃大樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which floor holds the reception?
dialogue.zh: 報到櫃台在幾樓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-second, take the fast elevator.
dialogue.zh: 二十二樓，搭那台快電梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the lobby need a pass?
dialogue.zh: 大廳也要通行證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they scan every badge twice.
dialogue.zh: 要，證照會掃兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The maps app shows heavy traffic.
dialogue.zh: 地圖顯示路上大塞車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the subway is our plan.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就改搭地鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do doors open?
dialogue.zh: 幾點開始入場？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six thirty, the talk starts at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈθɜrti, ðə tɔk stɑrts æt ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 六點半開，七點開講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's arrive early and stay calm.
dialogue.zh: 我們早點到，從容一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hate rushing through dinner.
dialogue.zh: 我最討厭趕著扒飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is valet parking available there?
dialogue.zh: 那邊有代客泊車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around twenty dollars for the night.
dialogue.zh: 停放一整晚約二十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charge your phone before leaving.
dialogue.zh: 出門前把手機充飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And bring a small power bank.
dialogue.zh: 再帶一個行動電源。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a short list of goals.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ə ʃɔrt lɪst ʌv ɡoʊlz./
dialogue.zh: 我想先列個簡短目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three people, three good conversations.
dialogue.zh: 認識三個人，深聊三場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Prepare one line about our work.
dialogue.zh: 準備一句介紹我們工作的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it simple and a little curious.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ˈsɪmpəl ənd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈkjʊriəs./
dialogue.zh: 簡單一點，還要讓人想追問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Practice it in the mirror once.
dialogue.zh: 對著鏡子練一次看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it feels much smoother.
dialogue.zh: 現在唸起來順多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know anyone attending?
dialogue.zh: 你認識會到場的人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mark from sales said maybe.
dialogue.zh: 業務部的馬克說可能來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text him our meeting spot.
dialogue.zh: 傳訊息跟他說碰面的地點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He replies slowly, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過他回訊息很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I get nervous there?
dialogue.zh: 當場緊張了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone stands awkwardly at first.
dialogue.zh: 大家剛開始都有點僵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I always forget names instantly.
dialogue.zh: 我總是馬上就忘記名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type them into your phone notes.
dialogue.zh: 趕快打字記在手機備忘裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring a notebook?
dialogue.zh: 我要帶筆記本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small one fits anywhere.
dialogue.zh: 小本子哪裡都塞得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lanyard is tangled again.
dialogue.zh: 我的掛繩又打結了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the spare clip in my drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə spɛr klɪp ɪn maɪ drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 用我抽屜那個備用夾子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you confirm the Friday plan?
dialogue.zh: 週五的安排你確認了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, waiting on one reply.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，還在等一個人回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The host sent a reminder email.
dialogue.zh: 主辦方發了提醒信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lists parking and dress code.
dialogue.zh: 裡面寫了停車和穿著規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any dietary note for dinner?
dialogue.zh: 晚餐要登記飲食限制嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I flagged the nut allergy.
dialogue.zh: 要，我註明了堅果過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we leave before the raffle?
dialogue.zh: 抽獎之前我們能先走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, nobody watches that part.
dialogue.zh: 可以啊，那個環節沒人看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I set an alarm for five fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛt ən əˈlɑrm fər faɪv fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 我設了五點十五的鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we must not be late.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們千萬別遲到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you bringing your own cards?
dialogue.zh: 你會帶自己的名片吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A dozen, plus a few spares.
dialogue.zh: 一打，再多幾張備用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we finally go.
dialogue.zh: 明天我們終於要去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm curious and a little nervous.
dialogue.zh: 我有點好奇，也有點緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, we registered online yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我們昨天線上報名了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, may I see your code?
dialogue.zh: 好的，可以給我看一下你的條碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is on my phone.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，我手機上的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scanning now, one moment please.
dialogue.zh: 正在掃，請稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my name spelled correctly here?
dialogue.zh: 我名字在這裡拼對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one letter looks wrong.
dialogue.zh: 差一點，有個字母看起來不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please add my middle name too.
dialogue.zh: 請把中間名也加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll reprint that in a second.
dialogue.zh: 我馬上幫你重印一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's your badge and the agenda.
dialogue.zh: 這是你的證，還有議程表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, where should I wear it?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這個要戴在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clip it on your left side.
dialogue.zh: 夾在左邊就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clip feels loose already.
dialogue.zh: 這夾子感覺已經有點鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the extra pin in that box.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ði ˈɛkstrə pɪn ɪn ðæt bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 試試那個盒子裡的別針。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That holds much better, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 這個牢固多了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your name tag has a red dot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr neɪm tæɡ hæz ə rɛd dɑt./
dialogue.zh: 你的名牌上有個紅點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means I'm open to talking.
dialogue.zh: 代表我歡迎跟人聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green dots mean staff, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin dɑts min stæf, baɪ ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對了，綠點代表工作人員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good to know before I ask around.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tu noʊ bɪˈfɔr aɪ æsk əˈraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 幸好先知道，免得亂問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the drink station tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚飲品站在哪邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left wall, past the tall plants.
dialogue.zh: 左邊牆那側，高盆栽後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the coffee machine working?
dialogue.zh: 咖啡機可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the line is long.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但排隊排很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they serve anything cold?
dialogue.zh: 有冰的可以喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sparkling water and iced tea.
dialogue.zh: 有氣泡水跟冰紅茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I grab two cups for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡræb tu kʌps fər ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 我去幫我們拿兩杯好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, mine is black, no sugar.
dialogue.zh: 好，我的黑咖啡不加糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wine glasses are over there.
dialogue.zh: 酒杯在那個角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one, I have an early start.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn, aɪ hæv ən ˈɜrli stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 一杯就好，我明天要早起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snacks are free on the side table.
dialogue.phonetic: /snæks ɑr fri æn ðə saɪd ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 邊桌上的小點是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those little sandwiches disappear fast.
dialogue.zh: 那種小三明治一下就光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind if I join this circle?
dialogue.zh: 我加入這邊聊天可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, grab a spot.
dialogue.zh: 當然不介意，過來擠個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't think we've met yet.
dialogue.zh: 我們應該還沒見過面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, I'm new to this crowd.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，這種場合我是新人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dana from Brightline.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是 Brightline 的 Dana。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, I'm Owen.
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，我是 Owen。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my card, my email is on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz maɪ kɑrd, maɪ ˈimel ɪz ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這是我名片，信箱印在上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, let me find mine for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, lɛt mi faɪnd maɪn fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我也找一張給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what do you actually do?
dialogue.zh: 那你們究竟在做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We build tools for warehouses.
dialogue.zh: 我們開發倉儲用的系統工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds very practical.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來真的很實用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, mostly long testing days.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，多是長到不行的測試日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which company did you say?
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛說是哪家公司？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Northgate, near the old harbor.
dialogue.zh: Northgate，在舊港區那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, your team spoke last year.
dialogue.zh: 噢，你們團隊去年來分享過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that was our product lead.
dialogue.zh: 對，那是我們的產品負責人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you been there?
dialogue.zh: 你在那邊做多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just over two years now.
dialogue.zh: 剛好超過兩年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you travel for that job?
dialogue.zh: 這份工作需要出差嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice a quarter, mostly south.
dialogue.zh: 一季兩次，主要跑南部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What part do you handle?
dialogue.zh: 你負責哪一塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Client support and a bit of training.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklaɪənt səˈpɔrt ənd ə bɪt ʌv ˈtreɪnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 客戶支援，也帶一點培訓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My job is mostly partnerships.
dialogue.zh: 我的工作主要是合作對接。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tonight suits you perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 那今晚太適合你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you looking for vendors today?
dialogue.zh: 你今天在找供應商嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, mainly just listening.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，主要先聽聽看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What brought you to this event?
dialogue.zh: 你是什麼原因來參加這場？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My boss said come and learn.
dialogue.zh: 老闆叫我來多學一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this your first networking night?
dialogue.zh: 這是你第一次來交流會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I came alone on purpose.
dialogue.zh: 對，我故意一個人來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That takes a bit of courage.
dialogue.zh: 那還需要一點勇氣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm fine now, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，我現在自在了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You work with my friend Rita.
dialogue.zh: 你跟我朋友 Rita 共事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small world, how do you know her?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wərld, haʊ du ju noʊ hɜr?/
dialogue.zh: 世界真小，你們怎麼認識？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We met at a training this spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mɛt æt ə ˈtreɪnɪŋ ðɪs sprɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 今年春天的培訓班認識的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She recommended this event to me.
dialogue.zh: 是她向我推薦這場活動的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you staying for the panel?
dialogue.zh: 接下來的論壇你留嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I saved a seat already.
dialogue.zh: 有留，我已經先佔了位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that your colleague by the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt jʊr ˈkɑliɡ baɪ ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 門口那個是你同事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's Mark from sales.
dialogue.zh: 對，那是業務部的馬克。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I say hi to him later?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ seɪ haɪ tu hɪm ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 待會兒我跟他打個招呼好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He'll wave you right over.
dialogue.zh: 他會招手叫你過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room feels crowded tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚這個廳好擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the balcony, it's calmer there.
dialogue.zh: 去陽台試試，那邊安靜些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, this noise hurts.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，這裡吵得頭疼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quiet corner would help a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwaɪət ˈkɔrnər wʊd hɛlp ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 能找到安靜角落就太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know when dinner starts?
dialogue.zh: 你知道晚餐幾點開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight sharp, right after the panel.
dialogue.zh: 八點整，論壇一結束就開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should eat something before that.
dialogue.zh: 那之前我得先墊點東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cheese table opens at seven thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃiz ˈteɪbəl ˈoʊpənz æt ˈsɛvən ˈθɜrti./
dialogue.zh: 起司桌七點半就開始了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take the leftover cookies?
dialogue.zh: 剩下的餅乾能帶走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the staff, they usually say yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə stæf, ðeɪ ˈjuʒəˌwəli seɪ jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 問工作人員，通常都會答應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a quiet room for calls?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈkwaɪət rum fər kɔlz?/
dialogue.zh: 有安靜的房間能接電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third door down the left hall.
dialogue.zh: 左側走廊進去第三間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone buzzed twice already.
dialogue.zh: 我手機已經震兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better check before the next talk.
dialogue.zh: 最好在下場開講前看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who organized this whole night?
dialogue.zh: 這整場活動是誰辦的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A local trade group, I heard.
dialogue.zh: 我聽說是個當地同業公會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they invite these speakers?
dialogue.zh: 這些講者都是他們請來的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some, others paid for a booth.
dialogue.zh: 部分是，其他是花錢設攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the media wall for photos?
dialogue.zh: 拍照的品牌背板在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Near the exit, with bright lights.
dialogue.zh: 靠近出口，燈光打得很亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like a photo there?
dialogue.zh: 你想去那邊拍一張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe later, my hair is messy.
dialogue.zh: 等一下再說，我頭髮有點亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people really swap cards here?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡真的會交換名片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Constantly, it's basically the rule.
dialogue.zh: 一直在換，那幾乎是鐵則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only have three cards left.
dialogue.zh: 我名片只剩下三張了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep one for the speaker, too.
dialogue.zh: 也幫講者留一張吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for talking with me.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你願意跟我聊這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You made this much easier.
dialogue.zh: 你讓我一下子放鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That keynote really surprised me.
dialogue.zh: 那場主題演講讓我意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The data slide stayed with me.
dialogue.zh: 那頁數據我到現在還記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you catch the pricing numbers?
dialogue.zh: 你有記下價格數字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I photographed it, want a copy?
dialogue.zh: 我拍了照，要給你一份嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please send it my way.
dialogue.zh: 請傳一份給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll send it after we trade cards.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛnd ɪt ˈæftər wi treɪd kɑrdz./
dialogue.zh: 換完名片我就傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you think of the speaker?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ju θɪŋk ʌv ðə ˈspikər?/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得這位講者怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear, though a little fast.
dialogue.zh: 內容清楚，只是語速偏快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her example about hospitals stuck.
dialogue.zh: 她舉的醫院例子我記住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, it felt very real.
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣，那個例子很貼近現實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I ask your name again?
dialogue.zh: 我可以再問一次你的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, it's Priya, P‑R‑I‑Y‑A.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ɪts ˈpriə, pi ɑr aɪ waɪ eɪ./
dialogue.zh: 當然，是 Priya，我拼給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, let me give you my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, lɛt mi ɡɪv ju maɪ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 來，這張名片給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second, let me find my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd, lɛt mi faɪnd maɪ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 稍等，我找一下我的名片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is operations your current title?
dialogue.zh: 你的現職是營運主管嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I lead operations now.
dialogue.zh: 對，我現在帶營運團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Congratulations, that's a big step.
dialogue.zh: 恭喜你，這是很大一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, it came quickly.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，其實升得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I note your email on this card?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ noʊt jʊr ˈimel ɑn ðɪs kɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 我在名片上記一下你的信箱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it's printed right there.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，就印在那一角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is your industry doing lately?
dialogue.zh: 你們業界最近情況如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Busy, but budgets are tighter.
dialogue.zh: 忙碌，但預算抓得更緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same here, everyone compares quotes.
dialogue.zh: 我們也一樣，大家都比價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap options flooded the market.
dialogue.zh: 低價方案把市場都淹沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see demand coming back?
dialogue.zh: 你有看到需求回溫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, maybe next quarter.
dialogue.zh: 還沒有，也許要等下季。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: AI changed our support team already.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪ aɪ tʃeɪndʒd ˈaʊər səˈpɔrt tim ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: AI 已經改變我們的客服組。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours too, mostly drafting replies.
dialogue.zh: 我們也是，主要用來起草回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that worry your staff?
dialogue.zh: 那會讓你們員工擔心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit, but we retrain people.
dialogue.zh: 有點，但我們會再培訓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Regulations are the bigger headache.
dialogue.zh: 法規才是更大的頭痛來源。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Definitely, audits doubled this year.
dialogue.zh: 真的，今年稽核次數翻倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are remote teams still growing?
dialogue.zh: 遠端團隊還在持續擴編嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slower now, hiring is careful.
dialogue.zh: 現在慢了，招人很保守。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your market report was useful.
dialogue.zh: 你們那份市場報告很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can share the updated PDF.
dialogue.zh: 我可以分享更新過的版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any trend surprised your team?
dialogue.zh: 有什麼趨勢讓你們吃驚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Customers prefer yearly plans now.
dialogue.zh: 客戶現在比較喜歡年繳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Interesting, we see the opposite.
dialogue.zh: 有意思，我們看到相反情況。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a comparison could help both.
dialogue.zh: 那互相比對對兩邊都有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could our teams work together?
dialogue.zh: 我們的團隊有機會合作嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Possibly, what would that look like?
dialogue.zh: 說不定，你說的是什麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small pilot, maybe six weeks.
dialogue.zh: 小型試點，也許六週就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That I can actually support.
dialogue.zh: 這個我確實能幫上忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who should I contact to start?
dialogue.zh: 要開始的話我該找誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Email Lena, she handles pilots.
dialogue.zh: 寫信給 Lena，她管試點案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would a short call next week help?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ə ʃɔrt kɔl nɛkst wik hɛlp?/
dialogue.zh: 下週通個短電話會有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Tuesday or Thursday morning.
dialogue.zh: 好，週二或週四上午都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we partner on the training?
dialogue.zh: 那場培訓我們能一起做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We lack instructors, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話我們缺講師人選。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have two available right now.
dialogue.zh: 我們兩位講師現在就有空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send me their short profiles.
dialogue.zh: 把她們的簡短介紹傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is pricing discussed this early?
dialogue.zh: 這麼早就談價格合適嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ballpark numbers, nothing signed.
dialogue.zh: 只抓個大概，還不用簽約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need a formal proposal?
dialogue.zh: 你們需要正式提案文件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pages is enough for now.
dialogue.zh: 以現在來說兩頁就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll draft it this weekend.
dialogue.zh: 我這週末先把初稿寫出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, I'll wait for it.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我就等你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, may I cut in briefly?
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我可以簡短插一句嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, we're nearly done.
dialogue.zh: 請說，我們也快聊完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I promised to meet one old client.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prəˈmɪst tu mit wʌn oʊld ˈklaɪənt./
dialogue.zh: 我答應去見一位舊客戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, enjoy the evening.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，你好好享受今晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was lovely meeting you both.
dialogue.zh: 很高興見到你們兩位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same for me, keep in touch.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我們保持聯絡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll stop taking cards for now.
dialogue.zh: 我暫時先不再收名片了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, my wallet is completely full.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，我錢包都塞到爆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more conversation, then food.
dialogue.zh: 再聊一個人，然後去吃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm heading to the long table.
dialogue.zh: 我要往那張長桌過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else do you want to meet?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɛls du ju wɑnt tu mit?/
dialogue.zh: 你還想認識哪一位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The woman at the startup booth.
dialogue.zh: 新創攤位那位女士。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I join that group politely?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ dʒɔɪn ðæt ɡrup pəˈlaɪtli?/
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼禮貌地加入那群人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for a pause, then say hi.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt fər ə pɔz, ðɛn seɪ haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 等他們說話的空檔再打招呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nodding helps you look friendly.
dialogue.zh: 點頭會讓你看起來友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, people mirror each other.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，人會互相模仿動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've said my line many times now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪv sɛd maɪ laɪn ˈmɛni taɪmz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那句自我介紹我講好多次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gets easier, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 我保證後面會越來越順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left a card on my plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn lɛft ə kɑrd ɑn maɪ pleɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有人把名片放在我盤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The team by the door collects those.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tim baɪ ðə dɔr kəˈlɛkts ðoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 門口那組人員會代收這類東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room is louder after the talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum ɪz ˈlaʊdər ˈæftər ðə tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 演講結束後場子更吵了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone stands up at once.
dialogue.zh: 所有人幾乎同時站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we move somewhere quieter?
dialogue.zh: 我們換個安靜點的地方好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner sofas are free now.
dialogue.zh: 角落那組沙發現在空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pardon me, is anyone sitting here?
dialogue.zh: 請問這裡有人坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's completely open, go ahead.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，完全空著，你坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, my feet really hurt.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我的腳站得好痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Standing events are underestimated.
dialogue.zh: 全程站著的活動真的有夠累人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card just slid off the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd dʒʌst slɪd ɔf ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 我的名片剛從桌上滑下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, I caught it for you.
dialogue.zh: 給，我幫你接住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver, seriously.
dialogue.zh: 說真的你幫了我大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, we all drop things.
dialogue.zh: 別客氣，大家都會掉東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The panelist answered one question only.
dialogue.zh: 那位與談人只回答了一題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The moderator kept rushing along.
dialogue.zh: 主持人一直在趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you ask about your own topic?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju æsk əˈbaʊt jʊr oʊn ˈtɑpɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 你有問到自己關心的題目嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I lost my chance there.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，那個機會我錯過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can email the speaker instead.
dialogue.zh: 你可以改寫信去問那位講者。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thought, her address is public.
dialogue.zh: 對哦，她的信箱是公開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I collected eleven cards tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我今晚收到十一張名片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a genuinely strong result.
dialogue.zh: 這成績真的相當不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should sort them before I forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ʃʊd sɔrt ðɛm bɪˈfɔr aɪ fərˈɡɛt./
dialogue.zh: 我得趁忘記前把它們分類。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write a small note on each back.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ə smɔl noʊt ɑn itʃ bæk./
dialogue.zh: 每張背面都寫個小記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The event finally wrapped up.
dialogue.zh: 活動總算全部結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My voice is tired from talking.
dialogue.zh: 我講到喉嚨都累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get your email tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚能跟你要個信箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll write it out slowly.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我慢慢寫給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that letter uppercase here?
dialogue.zh: 這個字母要大寫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, all lowercase, very simple.
dialogue.zh: 不用，全部小寫，很單純。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll add you on LinkedIn now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在就在 LinkedIn 上加你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I'll accept it right away.
dialogue.zh: 好，我馬上按通過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the invitation arrive yet?
dialogue.zh: 邀約通知送到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, I'll check once more.
dialogue.zh: 還沒有，我再看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's connect while it's fresh.
dialogue.zh: 趁印象還新趕快連結一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tomorrow I'll be buried.
dialogue.zh: 對，明天我會忙到翻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I message her on there too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈmɛsɪdʒ hɜr ɑn ðɛr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我也能在上面傳訊息給她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, the message box works.
dialogue.zh: 儘管傳，那個訊息框能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I thank her tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我今晚該不該謝謝她？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a short note goes far.
dialogue.zh: 該啊，短短幾句就很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How formal should the message be?
dialogue.zh: 那封信要多正式？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm but brief is perfect.
dialogue.zh: 親切又簡短就最剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll mention her keynote talk.
dialogue.zh: 我會提到她那場主講。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Speakers love specific feedback.
dialogue.zh: 講者最喜歡具體的回饋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you send yours already?
dialogue.zh: 你的信已經寄出去了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three notes in ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 寄了，十分鐘內寫了三封。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My message says thank you twice.
dialogue.zh: 我的信裡道了兩次謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fine, politeness never hurts.
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，禮貌永遠不吃虧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I attached the slide photo.
dialogue.zh: 我把那頁簡報拍照附上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, that's the chart she showed.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，那正是她簡報上的圖表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we copy the organizer here?
dialogue.zh: 這封信能不能副本給主辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if they agree first.
dialogue.zh: 得他們先點頭同意才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She replied in twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 她二十分鐘就回了信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That speed means real interest.
dialogue.zh: 回這麼快代表真有誠意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we meet for coffee soon?
dialogue.zh: 我們近期能約杯咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, what about next Wednesday?
dialogue.zh: 可以，下週三怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine works for me.
dialogue.zh: 九點對我剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll book the quiet place nearby.
dialogue.zh: 我訂附近那間安靜的咖啡廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is walking distance okay for you?
dialogue.zh: 走路可到達的距離你沒問題吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten minutes is plenty.
dialogue.zh: 可以，走路十分鐘就很夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll send a calendar invite.
dialogue.zh: 我會發一個行事曆邀請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, that keeps us honest.
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣兩邊都不容易忘記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the partnership notes along.
dialogue.zh: 把合作那份筆記一併帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're already in my bag.
dialogue.zh: 我早就放進包包裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you learn tonight?
dialogue.zh: 你今晚學到些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That preparation really matters.
dialogue.zh: 事前準備真的很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who was worth your time?
dialogue.zh: 誰值得你花時間認識？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Owen, and the operations woman.
dialogue.zh: Owen，還有營運那位女士。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did that one stand out?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼那一位特別突出？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She asked good questions back.
dialogue.zh: 她會反問很好的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wasted ten minutes at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈweɪstɪd tɛn ˈmɪnɪts æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我在門口白站了十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, just holding my drink.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，端著飲料發呆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I'll pick two people.
dialogue.zh: 下次我鎖定兩個人深聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's smarter than collecting cards.
dialogue.zh: 那比一直收名片聰明多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I talked too much about myself.
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛講太多自己的事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did the same, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，我也是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved six useful names.
dialogue.zh: 我記下了六個有用名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have four, maybe five.
dialogue.zh: 我四個，說不準五個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who should we contact first?
dialogue.zh: 我們該先聯絡哪一位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one with the pilot budget.
dialogue.zh: 手上有試點預算那位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hand is sore from handshakes.
dialogue.zh: 我握手握到手臂都酸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, at least twenty times.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，起碼二十次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you enjoy the food part?
dialogue.zh: 用餐那一段你喜歡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The line was too long for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪn wʌz tu lɔŋ fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 隊伍排太長，我乾脆沒吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The taxi stand is around back.
dialogue.zh: 排計程車的地點在建築物後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's walk, the air feels nice.
dialogue.zh: 我們走過去吧，空氣很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you miss the last subway?
dialogue.zh: 你是不是錯過末班地鐵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one train left at eleven.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，十一點還有一班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glad to be home at last.
dialogue.zh: 總算到家了，真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My ears are buzzing still.
dialogue.zh: 我耳朵到現在還在嗡嗡響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the follow-up begins.
dialogue.zh: 明天就要開始後續跟進。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll work through my card stack.
dialogue.zh: 我會一張一張整理名片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How soon is too soon to write?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ sun ɪz tu sun tu raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 多久寄信出去算太快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Within two days is ideal.
dialogue.zh: 兩天之內寄最剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she share the deck already?
dialogue.zh: 她把簡報檔分發了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, I'll chase her tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 還沒有，我明天再催她一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we use her case study?
dialogue.zh: 我們能用她的個案研究嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask permission, then cite her.
dialogue.zh: 先要授權，之後註明出處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The next event is in two months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst ɪˈvɛnt ɪz ɪn tu mʌnθs./
dialogue.zh: 下一場活動在兩個月後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same hall, different topic, right?
dialogue.zh: 同一個會場，主題不同，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tickets open October sixth.
dialogue.zh: 十月六日開賣門票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll set a reminder on my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛt ə rɪˈmaɪndər ɑn maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我會用手機設個提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we volunteer next round?
dialogue.zh: 下一輪我們要去當志工嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the fastest way to meet people.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈfæstəst weɪ tu mit ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 那是認識人最快的方法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They need help at the registration desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ nid hɛlp æt ði ˌrɛdʒɪsˈtreɪʃən dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 他們報到櫃台缺人手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I could take two hours there.
dialogue.zh: 我可以在那兒待兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who runs that volunteer team?
dialogue.zh: 志工團隊是誰在帶的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A calm woman named Grace.
dialogue.zh: 一位叫 Grace 的女士，個性很沉穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ask Owen to mention us first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æsk ˈoʊwən tu ˈmɛnʃən ʌs fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我會先請 Owen 幫我們提一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mentioning a name always opens doors.
dialogue.zh: 提到熟人的名字真的比較好敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time let's arrive by six.
dialogue.zh: 下次我們六點前就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, early is when it's relaxed.
dialogue.zh: 同意，早到才最放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring more cards this time.
dialogue.zh: 這次名片要多帶一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll order forty more today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天再加訂四十張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the organizer ask for feedback?
dialogue.zh: 主辦有徵求意見回饋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a five question form.
dialogue.zh: 有，一份五題的問卷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd suggest longer networking time.
dialogue.zh: 我會建議延長交流時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And better signage on each floor.
dialogue.zh: 還有每樓的指標要更清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you come with me next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju kʌm wɪθ mi nɛkst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 下次你願意跟我一起去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, save a seat for me.
dialogue.zh: 當然，幫我留個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll add it to our team calendar.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æd ɪt tu ˈaʊər tim ˈkæləndər./
dialogue.zh: 我會加進團隊的行事曆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, now I can sleep well.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，現在我能好好睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight was genuinely worth it.
dialogue.zh: 今晚的付出真的很值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two real leads, that's plenty.
dialogue.zh: 兩個真正機會，就很夠了。
